name: How long does it take to dry water-soaked carpet professionally?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to dry water-soaked carpet professionally?

acceptedAnswer.text: The drying time for water-soaked carpet can range from 3 to 5 days, though it can sometimes take longer depending on the severity of the water damage, the humidity levels, and the type of carpet and subflooring. Professionals use advanced moisture detection tools to ensure that the carpet, padding, and underlying structures are completely dry to prevent secondary damage like mold growth or structural issues. Consistent monitoring throughout the drying process is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional carpet drying typically takes 3 to 5 days, but can vary based on damage severity and environmental factors. Monitoring ensures complete dryness.
